caseName: National Federation of Independent Business v. Sebelius
caseNameFull: National Federation of Independent Business v. Kathleen Sebelius, Secretary of Health and Human Services Florida v. Department of Health and Human Services

opinions.text: H. Bartow Farr, III, Esquire, of Washington, D.C., is invited to brief and argue these cases, as amicus curiae, in support of the judgment of the Court of Appeals that the minimum coverage provision of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, 26 U.S.C. § 5000A, is severable from the entirety of the remainder of the Act.
